TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_BASE_SPHERE_FEATURES.why: "When you first learn the Sphere of the Hidden Eye, gain Analyze and Skill Affinity: Stealth" -- a one-time grant when the sphere is learned; Analyze itself is automated (combat/ext/mind_hidden_eye.py).

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SKILL_AFFINITY_STEALT.why: Gain proficiency in Dexterity (Stealth) (or a bonus talent if already proficient) when the sphere is learned -- a build-time choice, not a fight effect.

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_EXPERT_SCOUT.why: Gain Expertise in a chosen, already-proficient skill (Investigation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival) -- a build-time choice.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_SCOUNDREL_TRAINING.why: "When you learn Scoundrel: gain proficiency in Dexterity (Sleight of Hand); ... choose one Mortal Realm Scoundrel talent ... choose one Mortal Realm Trick talent" -- a one-time build-time grant, not something a fight runs.

TAL_SHADOW_WILLING_CREATURE.why: Folded into Second Silhouette's own "Willing Creature" option (reviewed_final.d/mind.json): the printed text is one of Second Silhouette's target-type branches, not a separate purchasable ability.

TAL_SHADOW_UNWILLING_CREATURE.why: Folded into Second Silhouette's own "Unwilling Creature" option (reviewed_final.d/mind.json), for the same reason as Willing Creature.

tianxia.talent.shadow.lingering_trace.why: Extends a Shadow Mark to 8 hours and gives direction/alive-or-not tracking across up to a mile: world-map tracking between scenes, not a fight effect (fights on this table do not run 8 hours).

TAL_UNMAKING_UNMAKE_THE_ANSWER.why: A reaction against "a barrier, shield, temporary construct, talisman effect, summoned asset, or ongoing defensive technique" being created: those show up on this table as zones, modifiers, conditions, or summons depending on the talent, with no single creation event a generic reaction can watch for reliably. Automating it well needs the owner to scope which of those forms actually appear at the table.

TAL_VOID_RETURN_TO_ZERO.why: "The chosen benefit does not take effect" needs a pre-emptive hook that runs before a triggering creature's own beneficial effect resolves; this table's reactions (typed_reactions) run after an effect has already happened. Erode Technique, the closest sibling Void talent, only reduces an already-applied benefit for the same reason -- it cannot prevent one either.

TAL_VOID_CAUSE_EMPTYING_REVERSAL.why: Same engine limitation as Return to Zero: "the triggering benefit fails" needs a pre-emptive interrupt this table's reaction timing does not have.

TAL_VOID_COST_DENYING_NEEDLE.why: Extends Void Needle's own "Cost Lock" option, which has no typed effect of its own yet (Void Needle is Tabik Damu's reviewed record; see the worker report). Low standalone value until Cost Lock's cost-reduction-denial exists to extend.

tianxia.talent.beauty.admiring_crowd_met.why: Requires an audience, crowd, court, sect hall, market, banquet, performance, or public gathering outside combat before it can be used; not a fight action.

tianxia.talent.beauty.lovely_monster_bea.why: A re-flavoring of Catch the Eye and other Beauty talents (fear/awe/horror instead of elegance/charm); it changes no number or condition the fight tracks.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_CLEANED_OUT.why: Taking or repositioning a second accessible object on a successful Steal: the table does not track a scene's loose objects/inventory to hand a second one to the thief.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_SKILL.why: Swaps an arbitrary named skill proficiency (the GM's choice of what the target "reasonably" has) between two creatures for 1 minute; the table does not run a generic proficiency-swap effect for GM-picked skills.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_DOUBLE_DIP.why: Lets a successful Dirty Trick apply two of its option-menu effects instead of one; Dirty Trick's own choose-one options are Tabik Damu's reviewed record, and safely extending its selection to two without touching that file needs a shared choose-two mechanism this table does not have yet.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_IMPOSSIBLE_FASTENING.why: Extends one Dirty Trick condition's duration from "until the start of your next turn" to 1 minute; needs a duration-override modifier this table does not have (the same gap as Long Shadow, reviewed_final.d/mind.json).

TAL_ILLUSION_GREATER_ILLUSION.why: Adds smell/taste/touch/temperature to figments and says those senses "cannot deal damage, heal, poison, burn, feed, deafen, suffocate, or physically move anything"; its one edge with fight weight (casual touch no longer reveals a figment) needs a touch-based illusion-detection check this table does not model.

TAL_ILLUSION_MISDIRECTION_RESPONSES.why: The five responses themselves are simple, but the trigger ("you may trigger a Misdirection Response") is granted piecemeal across several other Illusion talents' own text (Create Figment's False Premise, False Obstruction, Illusionary Terrain, Illusion Domain...); binding it correctly needs the owner to confirm which of those grants are actually in play for these two characters rather than over- or under-offering the response.

TAL_DARK_HIDE_IN_DARKNESS.why: While your Hide in Darkness Meld is active, you may use Hide inside your own Darkness even when visible. Granting this Meld to another creature is not yet automated.

TAL_DARK_EXTINGUISH.why: Extinguishing nonmagical light sources needs light-level tracking this table does not model (Darkness's own reviewed_final rider already says the same); its Cultivation-Check-to-counter-one-magical-flame-effect clause is a GM call made case by case, not a generic effect.
